documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

Additional functions in sportsdataverse.basketball.atrium that are not generated API-endpoint wrappers (those have their own reference pages): per-competition functions minted from the competition registry (each binds a base wrapper to one competition), plus hand-written wrappers, loaders, and helpers.

atrium_season_id(website_id: 'int', season: 'int', competition_id: 'Optional[str]' = None, **kwargs: 'Any') -> 'str' The seasonId of a site's season, from its END year and optionally its competition. Parameters Returns The season's UUID, for the season_id argument of every season-scoped wrapper. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.atrium import atrium_season_id atrium_season_id(14, 2026, competition_id="16be8396-24fb-11ef-9ab7-df6be196e88f")

atrium_end_year(website_id: 'Any', year: 'Any') -> 'Optional[int]' The sdv season key (END year) of a site's year, or None when it cannot be mapped. Parameters Returns year + 1 for site 12 (2025 -> 2026 = 2025-26), year for the calendar-year sites, None for an unregistered site, site 236 (no season list) or a non-integer year. A value that cannot be mapped returns None. Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.atrium import atrium_end_year atrium_end_year(12, 2025) # 2026 atrium_end_year(14, 2026) # 2026

lmb_pbp(fixture_id: 'str', locale: 'Optional[str]' = None, *, return_parsed: 'bool' = True, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False, **kwargs: 'Any') -> 'Union[pl.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, Dict]' Play-by-play of a Liga Mayor de Baloncesto (El Salvador) game. Liga Mayor de Baloncesto (El Salvador) (men's and women's); season rule: calendar year. Convenience wrapper: a thin binding of atrium_pbp to this competition, minted from the competition registry (tools/codegen/basketball_competitions.yaml). Read before use: Unofficial: this is the public endpoint the Sportradar Atrium / Synergy Connect widget calls from every visitor's browser (keyless; the host has no robots.txt). The data is Sportradar's and the leagues'. The wrappers read it on the caller's behalf, one request at least 1 s after the last, and never republish it as release assets. Keep crawls small and incremental. Women's competition data: flagged for the wehoop mirror (Phase C). Parameters Returns A polars/pandas DataFrame by default; the raw JSON Dict when return_parsed=False. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.atrium import lmb_schedule, lmb_pbp games = lmb_schedule() lmb_pbp(fixture_id=games['fixture_id'][0])

sportsdataverse.basketball.atrium — 22 endpoints. Note: Unofficial: this is the public endpoint the Sportradar Atrium / Synergy Connect widget calls from every visitor's browser (keyless; the host has no robots.txt). The data is Sportradar's and the leagues'. The wrappers read it on the caller's behalf, one request at least 1 s after the last, and never republish it as release assets. Keep crawls small and incremental. Note: website_id picks the league site (12 LNB France, 14 LNBP Mexico, 3 NBL1 Australia, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro); one site carries many competitions. Seasons are END years (season=2026): the site's own year is the START year on LNB and the calendar year elsewhere, and a year can hold several competitions, so pair season with competition_id (see atrium_seasons) or pass season_id directly. atrium_end_year(website_id, year) maps a site's own year to that END year. Note: Columns are configured per site: a statistic one site omits is null. The player and team ids are shared across sites; the player stat tables carry names only, so person_id there is decoded from the widget link beside each name.
